svg.aria-label: Sous — A kitchen agent for Alexa+ that keeps everyone at the table safe: dinner from food about to expire, allergy and diet risks blocked in code, groceries ordered only after a yes. CarbonPass — Verified embedded-emissions passports for EU CBAM: AI reads the invoices, a verifier signs, and on-chain tonnes can never be sold or claimed twice.
